Charles River Rowing

Hosted at Harvard's Newell Boathouse, this camp is for experienced athletes (1+ season) looking to gain deep insight into their rowing using Peach telemetry! You'll work closely with Pat Lapage and Tom Siddall to understand the key to unlocking more speed, both technically and physiologically. Dates: June 16-18, July 13-16, Aug 17-20 Register: www.charlesriverrowing.org
